roomdata: This is your bedroom.  It's a pretty standard room for a young college student.
You and your long time friend Tina are chatting around your house one night, when the subject of the hot new exclusive club comes up.

Your mom's living room is very clean, ordered and tidy.  You don't spend much time here or you'll get yelled at for dirtying up the room.
Plum street runs right outside your house, well your mom's house at least.  It is a quiet little road that doesn't have a lot of traffic on it.
You step outside of your house and run into none other than Tina.

"Oh my god!" she starts upon seeing you, "[v: pname], is that really you?!" she begins.

You flush with embarassment. "Yes, Tina, it's really me!" you start. "I told you I'd do whatever it takes to win that bet! Don't think you're getting out of it."

Tina begins to laugh. "Wow, I can see you're serious, [v: pname]," she begins checking you out. "You really have done a number on yourself! Just make sure you don't do too many permanent changes! I don't want to be the slave of another 'woman' for a weekend if you actually win!" she laughs.

Tina seems to think to herself for a bit.

"You know, [v: pname], I feel a little bit bad about tricking you into the bet since I knew it was a ladies only club. I'll help even up the odds a bit since you're obviously serious about winning the bet. I happen to have some extra strength female hormones with me. If you want them, I'll give them to you. Just take one a day and they'll help you pass as a woman. Just let me know if you want them," Tina smiles at you holding a pill bottle to you containing several pink pills.

Tina seems excited as she quickly hands the pills to you.

"That's great [v: pname]! I'm sure they'll help you out a lot!" she says happily.

"Well, I've got to run! Don't forget to snap a shot of you in the club if you manage to get in," Tina waves as she heads off down the road.

Did she seem a bit too eager to give you the pills, you wonder to yourself.

"OK, [v: pname], just trying to help you out," she winks at you.

"Well, I've got to take off. Good luck, it looks like you'll need it," she giggles as she heads off down the street.
The misty nothingness of the void surrounds you.
Apple street runs north-south and passes by Club Sapphos.  You can see a large line of people trying to get into the club to the west.
This is the outside of Club Sapphos.  It doesn't look like much out here, but you can hear the loud beats going on in the club.  It sounds like a seriously happening place.

This is the main room in Club Sapphos, featuring a dance floor, techno lights, and a great fully equipped bar.  There are even locations where club dancers are displayed on platforms, dancing in a provocative manner.

'Wow,' You think to yourself. 'You finally made it! It was a lot of hard work to get here, but you've done it!'

Now, you just need to get a picture of yourself in the club and you'll be able to get out of here and beat Tina at the bet!

'This place is pretty cool though,' you think to yourself. 'Perhaps I don't need to get out of here so fast.'
Orange street runs along the north of town, running right by the Orchards Mall.
The mall to the west appears to be currently closed.
The Orchards Mall, where everyone comes to buy gifts, clothes and services.  Almost everything you need can be found here, at the mall!
Jenny's shoes sells the finest ladies shoes around.  They have all styles of shoes, from contemporary, practical styles to the sleek daring heels for a night on the town.
Nandi's Secret sells all kinds of delightful undergarments for the discerning lady.  Only the best quality products are found here.
Bethany runs Petite Fashions, the women's clothing store in the mall.  They feature many different styles of clothes, from casual to formal wear.
This is the mall's salon.  Tiffany takes care of everything in here.  She looks up at you expectantly as you enter her shop.

You notice that Tiffany offers several permament solutions.  You're not sure why, but a brief image in your mind of you permanently large breasted, hairless with permanent makeup appears.  For some strange reason you get really excited by that vision.  You have no idea why that happened.
Jess is apparently very well off.  He mansion is gorgeous and looks to be very posh!
This is a nondescript dressing room, part of petite fashions.
Jess has a beautiful mansion.  There is a secretary's desk to one side of the living room.

"Ah, [v: fname], it's about time," Jess begins.

"Now, I've already bailed your sorry ass out of trouble. Now it's time for you to sign this contract and get to work paying me off."

Jess hands you a thick legal document. "Sign please and we can get started."
A luxurious bathroom.  Jess must have hired an excellent interior decorator.
Grisly hall is an ominous site.  You feel goosebumps on your legs and arms just looking at the foreboding structure.

Maggie smiles as she sees you approach.

"Thank goodness you're here. Sorry, but this place is creeping me out a bit," she continues.

"Well, let's get inside before it starts to rain," she says, handing you some lights to help carry in.
"Let me know when you're ready to go inside.  It's a bit scary I know, so you may need to nerve up for it." Maggie smiles at you.

This room hasn't been used in many, many years.  It has a thick coating of dust all over the walls and floors.  There are a few really nice pieces of furniture in here that are beginning to show signs of misuse and age.

You tentatively enter Grisly Hall. You and Maggie start setting up the equipment.

It isn't long before you two have put together a workable set. Grisly Hall looks perfect for a Halloween shoot! It creeps you out just being in here, but once the lights turn on, you somehow feel a bit safer.

"OK, we just need to try on a few outfits and take some shots," Maggie grins at you.
You both stop as you hear a strange noise throughout the house.

"I'm sure that was just the wind," Maggie says. Perhaps there's a draft blowing through a basement.

You are sure that she doesn't really believe that. Perhaps you should get this shoot done as quickly as possible and move on.

You search around a bit blindly with your hands.

After a few terrifying minutes, you stumble upon a small tea candle and matches that Maggie brought with her and you saw her set down.

You look around under the candle light, but can't seem to find Maggie anywhere! You do notice a door that's now open. You are sure it was closed before.

You investigate the door a bit further and see that it is a staircase going down.
You walk down the creaky stairs into the basement.  You think you can hear something.
You hear someone or something calling out the name "Sarah".  Could that be Maggie calling out for a friend?  You need to search for her quickly.  Perhaps she's in trouble!
You search around the room and eventually find what appears to be a well hidden door on the north side of the room.

You enter the strange room and see Maggie, sitting on the bed in this surprisingly well kept up room. She has a little doll in her hand.

You hear Maggie mumbling to herself, saying "Sarah, Sarah," to herself.
